terminos_titulo: Terms and Conditions of LPG Supply & Delivery
terminos_desc: Understand the safety, delivery, and warranty protocols governing every Solgas cylinder order placed through Gaswii.
vigencia_nota: Valid for Metropolitan Lima pursuant to OSINERGMIN safety regulations and Consumer Protection Code.
clausula_1_desc: Solgas Surquillo operates legally as an Authorized LPG Distributor registered with OSINERGMIN with active tax ID (RUC). All operations adhere strictly to safety rules issued by the Ministry of Energy and Mines.
clausula_2_desc: We serve Surquillo, Miraflores, San Borja, San Isidro, and neighboring districts. Average dispatch times range from 15 to 25 minutes, depending on traffic, weather, and peak demand.
clausula_3_desc: Every cylinder comes directly from the official bottling plant with an intact heat-shrink security seal certifying 100% pure and unadulterated LPG.
clausula_4_tit: 4. Exact Weight Check via Digital Scale
clausula_4_desc: Customers have the right to request a gross weight check (10 kg or 45 kg net gas plus cylinder tare) with the technician's calibrated digital scale prior to payment.
clausula_5_desc: We accept formal brand empty cylinders in sound physical condition according to Peru's universal exchange framework. Severely corroded, dented, or valve-damaged cylinders cannot be accepted.
clausula_6_desc: Upon request, the delivery technician will safely install the cylinder to your stove or water heater and carry out a gas leak test at no extra cost.
clausula_7_desc: We accept Cash, Yape, Plin, and Bank Transfers upon delivery. Instant electronic tax receipts (boletas and facturas) are provided as required by SUNAT.
clausula_8_desc: Orders may be cancelled or rescheduled without penalty by notifying our Hotline or WhatsApp before the delivery motorcycle reaches your address.
clausula_9_desc: In the rare event of valve malfunction within 24 hours of delivery, our team will immediately inspect and replace the cylinder free of charge.
clausula_10_desc: Any dispute shall be settled under the laws of the Republic of Peru and the jurisdiction of Lima courts, without prejudice to INDECOPI and OSINERGMIN consumer authorities.
